Dasgupta, His.. of Skt. Lit. I. p. 360 fn. 2.
For a historical an. literary study an. summary of contents see Har Bilas Sarda, JRAS (1913) 259-81 an. Chandra Prabha, Historical Mahākāvyas in Sanskrit p.. 145-78. On the genealogies in the work see J. Morison, Vienna Ori. Jour. VII. 188-92. On the historical facts from three unnoticed verses see Sarit Sekhar Majumdar, IHQ. XIV. 4. 1938, p.. 844-45.
